basic_details.job_title: Principal District & Sessions Judge, West Champaran Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Stenographer, Clerk and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Three support staff posts (one Stenographer, one Clerk and one Peon/Orderly) are to be filled on a contractual basis in the Evening Court, West Champaran, Bettiah. Only retired employees of the Civil Courts may apply. Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, West Champaran, on or before 17 December 2026, either personally or through registered post.

content_sections.heading: About West Champaran Civil Court
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Bettiah, West Champaran, which heads the West Champaran Judgeship in Bihar. The engagement is for support staff in the Evening Court of the West Champaran Judgeship at Bettiah. The notice states that the engagement follows guidelines and directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, West Champaran, on or before 17 December 2026. They can be submitted either personally (by hand) or through registered post. Because the notice sets a date of receipt, an application sent by post must reach the office by 17 December 2026; the date of posting does not count. Address as printed: Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, West Champaran (the letterhead reads Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Bettiah, West Champaran). Mode: in person or registered post. Application form: the notice does not attach or prescribe an application form.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a retired employee of the Civil Courts. Only those retired court employees who have retired within the last three years prior to the period, as per guidelines issued by the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, are eligible. The applicant must be physically and mentally fit to discharge the duties assigned to the respective post. The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service. Besides the common conditions, a Stenographer applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing. Besides the common conditions, a Clerk applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work. Besides the common conditions, a Peon/Orderly applicant must be capable of performing the duties attached to the post. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The notice does not mention an age limit. On pay, the notice says only that the period of engagement, remuneration and other conditions shall be governed by the applicable rules, guidelines and orders of the competent authority. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility conditions of each post.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in the West Champaran Civil Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts in total: 1 Stenographer, 1 Clerk and 1 Peon/Orderly, all in the Evening Court, West Champaran, Bettiah.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, West Champaran, on or before 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for these Evening Court posts?
faq.answer: Only retired employees of the Civil Courts may apply. They must have retired within the last three years prior to the period, as per guidelines of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna.

faq.question: Q4. What eligibility is needed for the Stenographer post?
faq.answer: A Stenographer applicant must have the requisite experience and proficiency in shorthand and typing, in addition to being an eligible retired Civil Court employee.

faq.question: Q5. What eligibility is needed for the Clerk post?
faq.answer: A Clerk applicant must have adequate knowledge and experience of clerical and judicial office work, in addition to being an eligible retired Civil Court employee.

faq.question: Q6. How do I submit the application?
faq.answer: The application can be submitted personally or sent through registered post to the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, West Champaran, so that it reaches by 17 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely contractual, can be terminated at any time as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Patna, and does not confer any right to claim regular appointment or continuation in service.

faq.question: Q8. What are the working hours for the selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates must perform their duties for a minimum of 05 hours on each working day.

faq.question: Q9. Can a retired employee with a past disciplinary punishment apply?
faq.answer: The applicant must possess satisfactory service records and should not have been subjected to any major disciplinary punishment during service.
